data.gender_notes: Athallia is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word 'athalos', meaning 'inevitable' or 'unavoidable'. In Greek mythology, Athallia was a goddess of the heights, mountains, and fortresses. She was often invoked for protection and strength. The name Athallia carries the meaning “Goddess of the heights” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Athallia usually hope their child will grow to embody goddess of the heights and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of strength and protection, inspiring courage and resilience.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Athallia total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.
